scope: Standalone append journal, not production app history routing
held_findings: Undo repeats retain for each appended endpoint and can be quadratic for high degree base vertex; deduplicate touched IDs.
Each command copies all base UUIDs, positions and endpoints: memory scales with base size times history depth; requires shared revision identity design.
Spatial index rebuild allocates after mutation; complete allocation-failure atomicity remains unproved.
decision: Retain proof; await corrections before integration.
